verb.description: Pre-turn hook verifying SSH signatures against mike's public key and authenticating as ssh:mike
verb.dockerfile:
FROM mshkn-base
RUN mkdir -p /verb && printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/bash' 'DATA="$1"' 'MSG=$(echo "$DATA" | sed -n "s/.*\"msg\":\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/p")' 'SIG=$(echo "$DATA" | sed -n "s/.*\"signature\":\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/p")' 'ALLOWED=/tmp/allowed.txt' 'SIGFILE=/tmp/sig.txt' 'printf "mike namespaces=mshkn ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIDKjcMzKVBZnfIMTxJFnn9gtLHsFa1+XT4Z3IENq2VgA" > "$ALLOWED"' 'printf "%s" "$SIG" > "$SIGFILE"' 'printf "%s" "$MSG" | ssh-keygen -Y verify -f "$ALLOWED" -n mshkn -s "$SIGFILE" 2>&1' 'RC=$?' 'rm -f "$ALLOWED" "$SIGFILE"' 'if [ "$RC" = "0" ]; then echo mike; fi' 'exit "$RC"' > /verb/run.sh && chmod +x /verb/run.sh
ENTRYPOINT ["/verb/run.sh"]
verb.name: ssh_verify_hook
